# foundry_evaluation (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["evaluations"]` on the provider. Preview features may change their inputs, outputs, or behavior in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up a Foundry evaluation definition by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluations are a preview feature; opt in on the provider block:
# provider "foundry" {
#   enable_preview = ["evaluations"]
# }

data "foundry_evaluation" "support_quality" {
  id = "eval_abc123"
}

output "testing_criteria" {
  value = data.foundry_evaluation.support_quality.testing_criteria
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Service-assigned evaluation identifier.

### Read-Only

- `data_source_item_schema` (String) JSON schema (as a JSON-encoded string) describing a single evaluation data item.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the evaluation.
- `name` (String) Name of the evaluation.
- `testing_criteria` (Attributes List) Testing criteria evaluated against each data source item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--testing_criteria))

<a id="nestedatt--testing_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `testing_criteria`

Read-Only:

- `data_mapping` (Map of String) Maps evaluator input field names to data item field references.
- `evaluator_name` (String) Name of the referenced evaluator.
- `evaluator_version` (String) Evaluator version pinned by this criterion, if any.
- `name` (String) Name of this testing criterion within the evaluation.
